 (a) That this Hon'ble Court be pleased to issue  writ of Mandamus or any other appropriate writ  order or direction in the nature thereof and  thereby, the respondent may be directed to accept  the candidature of the petitioner on the post of  Food Safety Officer as the petitioner secured  marks in the merit list;
 (b) That the hon'ble court be pleased to reserved  one seat in the selection process for the post of  food safety officer to be allocated specifically for  the petitioner, considering his eligibility,
 qualification and the injustice faced during the  recruitment process;
 (c) Pass such other and further order(s) as may  deem fit and proper and in the interest of justice  and protect the rights and interests of persons  with disabilities.
2. Learned counsel for the petitioner while placing reliance upon the dictum encapsulated in Sakshi Apurva vs. State of Rajasthan registered as S.B. Civil Writ Petition No.
5343/2024 has submitted that vide order dated 20.04.2024 an interim protection was granted to the petitioner whereby, the petitioner was provisionally permitted to appear and be considered Rajesh Kumar S/O Shri Balbir Singh vs Additional Chief Secretary (Acs) ... on 21 November, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/64011529/
2  (Downloaded on 28/11/2024 at 09:52:54 PM)

in the said selection process, and one seat was kept vacant qua the petitioner. It is further submitted that petitioners' educational background is rooted in Tamil Nadu and petitioner has degree in Bachelor of Science in Botany, Zoology and Chemistry. 
3. Further, it is submitted that the petitioners' qualification is equal to the qualification as enshrined and considered mandatory in the advertisement dated 21.10.2022. The said requirement qua qualification is reproduced as below:-
 ""kS{kf.kd ;ksX;rk%&
 1. (i) A degree in Food Technology or Dairy technology  or Biotechnology or Oil Technology or Agriculture  Science or Veterinary Sciences or Bio-Chemistry or  Microbiology or Masters Degree in Chemistry or  Degree in Medicine from a recognized University."
4. Sequentially, learned counsel for the petitioner has submitted that the petitioner is ought to be considered for the said post. 
Additionally, it is submitted that petitioner is an ex-serviceman and deserves the relaxation qua educational qualification and the respondents have not granted the said relaxation to the petitioner,
moreover the said action of the respondents is against the DOPT Circular. 
5. Per contra, learned counsel representing the State and RPSC has taken a preliminary objection qua the maintainability of the present petition on the ground that afore-cited judgment i.e.
Sakshi Apurva (supra) is dismissed by the concerned Court and the said decision qua dismissal is affirmed by the Division Bench,
therefore the interim protection so effectuated should be vacated Rajesh Kumar S/O Shri Balbir Singh vs Additional Chief Secretary (Acs) ... on 21 November, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/64011529/
3 and the petition should be dismissed at the threshold.
 (Downloaded on 28/11/2024 at 09:52:54 PM) 
 [2024:RJ-JP:47792] (4 of 5) [CW-16318/2024]
6. It is further submitted that vide advertisement dated 21.10.2022, it is made clear that the eligibility criteria is categorical and specific, therefore educational qualification possessed by the petitioner cannot be considered equivalent with those provided in the advertisement. Moreover, the degree specified in the advertisement and degree possessed by the petitioner, are of different fields and have no co-relation. The same is reproduced as below:-
 "The Board of Management of the Vinayaka  Mission's Research Foundation hereby makes known  that  Toda Ram Bijaraniya has been admitted to the  Degree of BACHELOR OF SCIENCE IN BOTANY,
 ZOOLOGY, CHEMISTRY having been certified by  duly appointed Examiners to have qualified to  receive the same at the Examination held in APR-  2015 and placed in SECOND class. 
 Given under the seal of the University. 
 Under Section 3 of the UGC Act, 1956." 
7. Furthermore, it is submitted that failure in fulfilling of the basic requirement qua degree/qualification renders the argument qua ex-serviceman and relaxation pertaining to education qualification irrelevant. 
8. Heard.
9. Considering the arguments advanced by the learned counsel for the parties and scanning the judgments cited by the counsel,
this Court deems it apposite to dismiss the present petition on the Rajesh Kumar S/O Shri Balbir Singh vs Additional Chief Secretary (Acs) ... on 21 November, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/64011529/

Accordingly, the instant petition (S.B. Civil Writ Petition No. 16318/2024) is disposed of. Pending applications, if any, shall stand disposed of.
